notes: Append-optimised time-series engine with a PostgreSQL wire endpoint. Tables with a designated timestamp are partitioned by month (WAL). No primary keys / foreign keys / UPDATE-heavy workloads; replication is an Enterprise feature.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INT,
  name VARCHAR,
  email VARCHAR,
  country_code SYMBOL CAPACITY 256 CACHE,
  tier SYMBOL CAPACITY 256 CACHE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP,
  attrs VARCHAR
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INT,
  parent_id INT,
  name VARCHAR,
  depth INT
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INT,
  category_id INT,
  sku VARCHAR,
  name VARCHAR,
  description VARCHAR,
  price DOUBLE,
  attrs VARCHAR,
  active BOOLEAN
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INT,
  customer_id INT,
  status SYMBOL CAPACITY 256 CACHE,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP,
  total_amount DOUBLE,
  shipping_country SYMBOL CAPACITY 256 CACHE
) TIMESTAMP(ordered_at) PARTITION BY MONTH WAL

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INT,
  order_id INT,
  product_id INT,
  qty INT,
  unit_price DOUBLE
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id LONG,
  customer_id INT,
  event_type SYMBOL CAPACITY 256 CACHE,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP,
  payload VARCHAR,
  value_num DOUBLE
) TIMESTAMP(occurred_at) PARTITION BY MONTH WAL

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INT,
  warehouse_id INT,
  qty INT,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP
)
